author: Claude (independent verification track)
candidate: SLACK-COVER (static final-orbit-set condition at COLLISIONS = c < 5)
scope: Q2 / Area-A. No frontier re-run, no continuation search, no revisiting of the Round-78 c=5 UNSAT instances. The only search is a finite static feasibility decision on the fixed orbit-hexagon incidence system.

derivation.identity_U: |U| = 5K - b, with K = 25 - O and b = 5 - c
derivation.excess_identity: for any K blocks, 5K - |union \ C| = sum_{h in C} m(h) + sum_{h in U} max(m(h)-1,0)
derivation.excess_is_forced: if the chosen blocks cover U then union \ C = U exactly, so EXCESS = 5K - |U| = b EXACTLY -- 'excess at most b' is not an independent constraint but the counting slack in the cover, attained automatically
derivation.surviving_constraint: SLACK-COVER: exactly K currently-closed orbits whose 5-hexagon blocks COVER U; per-block consequence |block & C| <= b
derivation.reduction_at_b0: at b = 0 every block must lie in U and the blocks must be disjoint, recovering Round 78's exact cover exactly
derivation.candidate_family_is_a_function_of_U_and_: any orbit meeting U is automatically closed (0 failures in 20,000 random configurations)

validation.positive_control: 620 instances synthesised from a known 25-orbit covering family (guaranteed satisfiable), spread over slack 0-4: 0 solver failures
validation.no_unknowns: 0 node-cap UNKNOWNs in any band; max search 20,178 nodes

ledger.roots_fully_closed: 28 of 33 -- every long root now clear

method_status.assessment: the static final-orbit-set method decays monotonically with slack and has ZERO power at b = 4: all 1,001 c=1 states are SAT. Every band was decided completely, so the static incidence condition is saturated as stated; going further needs a mechanism it cannot see -- the ORDER in which the K orbits may legally be opened, or their interaction with the fragment-repair obligation.

disclaimer: This project has not proved L6 >= 872, and nothing here bears on that.
